mapper.select: SELECT id, catalog_id, subject_id, question_text, choice1, choice2, choice3, choice4, answer_no, explanation, created_at FROM certification_question WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO certification_question (catalog_id, subject_id, question_text, choice1, choice2, choice3, choice4, answer_no, explanation, deleted) VALUES (#{catalogId}, #{subjectId}, #{questionText}, #{choice1}, #{choice2}, #{choice3}, #{choice4}, #{answerNo}, #{explanation}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE certification_question SET subject_id = #{subjectId}, question_text = #{questionText}, choice1 = #{choice1}, choice2 = #{choice2}, choice3 = #{choice3}, choice4 = #{choice4}, answer_no = #{answerNo}, explanation = #{explanation} WHERE id = #{id}
